portal_description:
The redhat-support-lib-python package contains the Red Hat Support Software
Development Library. Red Hat customers can use the library to easily
integrate their help desk solutions, IT infrastructure, and others with the
services provided by the Red Hat Customer Portal. The library provided by
this package is an abstraction layer that simplifies interactions with the
Red Hat Customer Portal.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Add support for handling JSON response from API's (BZ#1653574)

* Add support to upload to and download from S3 (BZ#1765391)

* Add support to upload to and download from S3 (BZ#1765392)

* Add support for handling JSON response from API's (BZ#2030063)

* RHST should use new Red Hat Secure FTP instead of dropbox for attachments (BZ#2030065)

* RHST should use new Red Hat Secure FTP instead of dropbox for attachments (BZ#2030066)
